Measured empirically with pi -p: a 20k-word prompt answers normally; 25k, 40k and 80k words return exit 0 with EMPTY stdout and EMPTY stderr — the same silent empty-turn failure a bad model id produces. So the real usable window is roughly 25-30k tokens, not 1.31M. In agent mode that surfaced as: request -> Cloudflare 400 (no body) -> pi reads it as 'Context overflow detected' -> auto-compacts at ~48-51k -> retries. All four workers compacted repeatedly at 48-51k while pi's status line said they were at 3.7% of 1.3M. wgi died outright: 'Context overflow recovery failed: Summarization failed: 408' — the recovery summarisation exceeded the same ceiling. Fix: modelOverrides now set contextWindow 24576 and maxTokens 8192 for both models, so pi compacts on its own schedule instead of discovering the limit through a provider rejection. Note this is separate from the 429 rate limit; the 400/408 family is this, the 429 is concurrency.
